name: code-atlas
description: AI-guided codebase walkthroughs. Interactive tours of repos, PRs, subsystems, and execution flows.

codeAtlas.anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key for LLM-backed tour generation. Leave empty to use the mock provider.
codeAtlas.anthropicApiKey.markdownDescription: Anthropic API key. Store securely — prefer `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` env var or VS Code secret storage in production.

codeAtlas.model.description: Anthropic model id used for tour generation.

codeAtlas.mcpEnabled.description: Run an MCP server so external agents (Claude Code, etc.) can drive Code Atlas tours.

codeAtlas.mcpPort.description: Preferred port for the Code Atlas MCP HTTP server on 127.0.0.1. If in use, the extension probes the next mcpPortRange ports.

codeAtlas.mcpPortRange.description: Number of consecutive ports to probe starting at mcpPort before giving up.

enumDescriptions: Local Kokoro-82M neural voice (experimental). Free and natural; runs in a background Web Worker via WASM and downloads a ~80MB model on first use. Inference is CPU-heavy and slow on some machines — falls back to the system voice if it stalls.
Browser SpeechSynthesis using native OS voices. Free, instant, works offline. Robotic but reliable — the default.
Shell out to a system command (macOS `say`; override via codeAtlas.tts.command on Linux).
ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 — natural hosted voice with low latency. Requires codeAtlas.tts.elevenLabsApiKey.
OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts — natural, tone-steerable hosted voice. Requires codeAtlas.tts.openAiApiKey.
codeAtlas.tts.provider.markdownDescription: Which engine reads tour narration aloud. **system** (default) uses free native OS voices — instant and reliable. **kokoro** is a free, natural neural voice that runs locally in a background worker, but model load/inference is CPU-heavy (experimental). **say** shells out to a command. **elevenlabs**/**openai** are hosted neural voices that need an API key.

codeAtlas.tts.command.description: Command invoked when codeAtlas.tts.provider is 'say'. The narration text is passed as a single argv[1]. Use `espeak` or `spd-say` on Linux.

codeAtlas.tts.kokoroVoice.description: Kokoro voice id used when codeAtlas.tts.provider is 'kokoro' (e.g. af_heart, af_bella, af_nicole, am_michael, am_adam, bf_emma, bm_george).

codeAtlas.tts.elevenLabsApiKey.markdownDescription: ElevenLabs API key, used when provider is 'elevenlabs'. Falls back to the `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` env var. Prefer the env var or secret storage over committing a key.

codeAtlas.tts.elevenLabsModel.description: ElevenLabs model id. eleven_flash_v2_5 is the low-latency default; eleven_multilingual_v2 is higher quality but slower and pricier.

codeAtlas.tts.openAiApiKey.markdownDescription: OpenAI API key, used when provider is 'openai'. Falls back to the `OPENAI_API_KEY` env var.

codeAtlas.tts.openAiVoice.description: OpenAI TTS voice (alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, sage, shimmer, verse).

codeAtlas.tts.openAiInstructions.default: Read this code walkthrough aloud like a friendly senior engineer pair-programming: clear, calm, with natural pacing.
codeAtlas.tts.openAiInstructions.description: Tone/style instructions passed to gpt-4o-mini-tts. Only the gpt-4o-mini-tts model honors this.
